assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: The blue shore circle with centre O, the landing point L at distance r from O, and the dashed circle of radius 1 around L meeting the shore at X and Y; red segments LX and LY of length 1, the dashed radius OX of length 1, and a green sector at L showing the surviving directions away from O.

difficulty_rationale: Requires setting up the distance to the shore in a random direction and reducing the survival condition to cos(phi) >= -r/2, then reading off the bounds.
